How to Find a Yard Sale in Your Area

Finding a yard sale in your area is easier than ever before! Before we had access to the latest technology, you would have to search through the listings published in the print newspaper to find a yard sale. Whether you are looking for knick-knacks, a bike for your kids, or maybe gently worn furniture for your new home, you can find it all at a yard sale. Our dedicated Corpus Christi movers are here to share how to find a yard sale in your area.

Yard Sale Apps

You can find a yard sale in your area all on your mobile device with yard sale applications. Our local Corpus Christi movers have a few suggestions for yard sale apps to help you in this process.

1. Yard Sale Treasure Map

One of the best yard sale apps is Yard Sale Treasure Map. This is a free app for iOS and Android users that will take Craigslist listings and inputs the location on Google Maps, so you can quickly find yard sales in your area. You will be able to see all garage sales within a 20-mile radius. There is also a feature where you can view the complete Craigslist posting with all the details you may need to determine which yard sale to check out. The paid version unlocks other features where you can create a route from sale to sale and search for specific items.

2. Garage Sales by Map

Another excellent yard sale app is Garage Sales by Map. Garage Sales is a free app that is available for both iOS and Android that helps you find garage sales in your area displayed on a map. Similar to Yard Sale Treasure Map, you can view the entire Craigslist ad within the app so you can quickly find them at a later time. This app will display the days and hours of the sale directly in the app, so you haven't keep going back to the ads to find this information.

Yard Sale Websites

If you prefer to find yard sales in your area on a larger screen, there are many websites that are great for you! Our residential Corpus Christi movers have created a list of recommended sites to help you discover yard sales in your area.

1. Garage Sales Tracker

A fantastic yard sale website is Garage Sales Tracker. This is a website where you can search for garage sales in your area that are on the site. Each listing has the date, time, address, details, and photos to browse through. You can also set up alerts to stay in the loop when a new sale is posted. However, you are going to find this site useful if your area has sellers who are actively posting their listings on this website.

2. Craigslist

One of the best ways to find garage sales is through Craigslist. People will post upcoming yard sales on this popular local forum, often with photos of items for sale.
